explanation: Bong Joon-ho's film was the first in a language other than English to win Best Picture. It had already won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2019.

claims.text: Bong Joon-ho's Parasite won Best Picture at the Academy Awards ceremony held in 2020.
Oldboy, Train to Busan and Burning did not win Best Picture, and Bong Joon-ho directed none of them.
Parasite was the first film in a language other than English to win Best Picture.
Parasite won the Palme d'Or at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival.
